sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the respondent- State submits that the chhath ghat which had been constructed over the private raiyati land of the petitioner has already stood removed and as far as the road in question is concerned, steps have been taken to acquire the land in question and pay adequate compensation as per the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Settlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act, 2013').
At this juncture, the learned counsel for the respondent-State adds that though the compensation would be paid under the Act, 2013, however, the acquisition is being made under the Bihar Raiyati Land Lease Policy, 2014.
